subject: Close window consolidation: proposed binding calendar & deferment protocol
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>, Gina Thomas <gina.thomas@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed MAP + binding calendar to protect current close window

Hi Liam / Gina,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, attaching a suggested MAP (v2) and a proposed "binding calendar" that locks deliverables and clear dates for procurement, security evidence, and final contract sign-off. The goal: avoid last-minute slip by making each dependency explicit and owned.

Key asks from Acme side: SOC 2 evidence (we outlined what is required), procurement approval checklist, and a signed SOW by the close date. From our side, we can commit to a dedicated pilot environment and a short-term credit if specific milestones are met.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm which procurement approver will own the 6/30 sign-off (suggest Liam).
- Indicate any mandatory blackout dates in June (procurement/legal).
- Review attached MAP and flag any missing milestones by EOD Friday.

I attached redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx and a stub listing the SOC 2 artifacts we can provide. If procurement needs tighter gating, we can escalate to a short SLA exception with an emplaced fallback.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), soc2-evidence-stub.txt (doc)

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Gina Thomas <gina.thomas@acme.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + binding calendar to protect current close window

Irene,

Appreciate the clarity and the MAP. Quick update from procurement/security: our SOC 2 review is still queued with internal audit — they flagged two open items (data-retention policy alignment and KMS integration specifics). That makes a hard 6/30 sign-off risky.

We want to keep the momentum but can't promise an exact sign date until those two items have evidence. Would Redwood be open to a contingency plan that holds the 6/30 slot for a 7-day grace period contingent on delivered evidence (and with a capped credit if we move past 7 days)?

Also, Gina will need a technical confirmation that the pilot will run in an isolated VPC for the procurement PoC.

Liam
Procurement Lead, Acme Corporation
procurement@acme.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + binding calendar to protect current close window

Liam — thanks for the signal. We can accommodate the ask. Proposed path:

1) Immediate: provide an expanded SOC 2 evidence packet focused on data-retention and KMS configuration by EOD Thursday (we'll include config snippets and an audit excerpt).
2) Pilot: spin up an isolated VPC pilot environment (30-day window) that Gina can validate.
3) Holding mechanism: Redwood will reserve the current 6/30 close date and offer a 7-day grace window for evidence delivery. If evidence arrives within the window, no pricing change. If we pass 7 days, Redwood will apply a one-time credit to Acme's invoice equal to 5% of first month committed spend to offset the delay.

If that sounds workable, I'll update the attached MAP with those clauses and a short acceptance checkbox for procurement to sign.

- Jonas
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Quoted for context:
> On 2027-06-20 11:03, Liam O'Neill wrote:
> > Irene,
> > 
> > Appreciate the clarity... (SOC 2 review queued)

Attachments: contract-draft_ACME_v3.pdf (draft contract for review)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + binding calendar to protect current close window

Quick internal note — if procurement pushes beyond the 7-day grace, we should be prepared to escalate a one-time exec credit approval to protect the RPO and projected MRR. I can take the ask to finance for pre-approval up to 7% if needed, with the understanding we need a firm commitment date within 30 days.

Also recommend we add a short "evidence acceptance" checklist to the MAP so audit has a clear pass/fail for the two SOC items. Saves time and avoids back-and-forth.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>, Gina Thomas <gina.thomas@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized MAP v2 + holding terms (please review & accept)

Hi Liam / Gina,

Per Jonas and Ben's notes I attached MAP v2 with:
- an explicit evidence checklist for the SOC 2 items (data retention + KMS)
- the isolated VPC pilot offering and acceptance steps
- the 7-day grace holding the 6/30 close and the 5% credit if delayed beyond that window (Ben is taking a finance pre-approval to 7% if needed).

Action items for Acme: please confirm by reply which person will check the acceptance box on the MAP (name + title) and confirm if Gina accepts the VPC pilot terms. If you accept the MAP language we will mark the 6/30 as "reserved" in our internal calendar and freeze the current pricing and onboarding slot.

If procurement needs a DocuSign quick-ack rather than email, we can send that link this afternoon.

Thanks,
Irene

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx, contract-draft_ACME_v3.pdf

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Gina Thomas <gina.thomas@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finalized MAP v2 + holding terms (please review & accept)

Irene / team,

Thanks — we reviewed the MAP and appreciate the clear checklist. Gina confirmed the isolated VPC pilot is acceptable. I am the procurement owner and will serve as the acceptance signatory.

We can commit to uploading the required SOC 2 artifacts into your shared Drive by 2027-06-29 17:00 PT. With that, Acme accepts the 7-day holding window; we agree to the 5% credit if we exceed the grace period (and appreciate Ben's escalation to 7% cap if finance approves).

Please send the DocuSign and the final MAP acceptance checkbox so I can route through procurement. Once the pilot VPC is provisioned, Gina will validate the environment and provide her thumbs-up.

Liam
Procurement Lead, Acme Corporation
